comment.body:
Thanks for reporting this issue. The report identifies the behavior ("Do not allow me to create a short cut to sent a text with Win Shift A"), but additional diagnostic evidence is needed to determine the exact failure mechanism and isolate whether this is a code regression or configuration issue.

Please provide:
1. Numbered steps that reproduce the problem from a clean PowerToys start, including exact Windows and PowerToys versions.
2. A fresh diagnostic archive captured immediately after reproducing by adding a comment containing /bugreport.

These details will help us investigate the failing path and prepare a targeted fix.
